title.zh: 工艺位置：先印稀疏母图形，再做倍频
title.en: Process position: print sparse parent patterns, then double density

subtitle.zh: 初始光刻 / 侧墙倍频 / 目标层转移
subtitle.en: Initial lithography / spacer doubling / target-layer transfer

body.zh: 01 光刻定义稀疏 Mandrel → 02 刻蚀形成 Mandrel → 03 SADP 侧墙倍频 → 04 转移到硬掩膜或目标层。整体分为初始光刻、SADP 倍频模块、最终图形转移。
body.en: 01 Lithographically define sparse mandrels → 02 etch mandrels → 03 SADP spacer doubling → 04 transfer to hard mask or target. Overall stages: initial lithography, SADP doubling module, final transfer.

body.zh: SADP 不是两次相同线图形曝光，也不只是多沉积一层 Spacer。它位于初始光刻与最终目标层之间，把部分分辨率压力转移给薄膜与刻蚀控制。
body.en: SADP is neither two identical line-pattern exposures nor merely an extra spacer deposition. Between initial lithography and final target layer, it transfers part of the resolution burden to film and etch control.

body.zh: 量测 Mandrel CD、Pitch、侧壁、CDU。使用顶视图 CD-SEM、截面轮廓与晶圆 CD 分布（红色 CD 大、蓝色 CD 小）。反馈流程：复测 → Hold → 判断是否进入 Spacer 模块。
body.en: Measure mandrel CD, pitch, sidewalls, and CDU using top-down CD-SEM, cross-sectional profiles, and wafer CD maps (red large, blue small). Feedback: remeasure → hold → decide whether to enter the spacer module.

body.zh: Fin、存储结构与 BEOL 金属层的材料堆栈可能不同。
body.en: Material stacks may differ for fins, memory structures, and BEOL metal layers.

uncertain: 页末水印与实质文字或图示区域重叠；figureCrop保留完整图表，未猜测补画遮挡区域。
